newsitem.title: UK: Treasuries recover from lows in London, FOMC looms.
newsitem.headline: Treasuries recover from lows in London, FOMC looms.

text.p: U.S. Treasuries' losses in Asian time brought buyers in London out of the woodwork on Tuesday, pushing the market off overnight lows, traders said.
But they added gains were likely to be limited ahead of a meeting of the U.S. Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC), the policy-making arm of the Federal Reserve.

"The market came off a fair chunk from New York levels in Asia, but we're seeing a reasonable amount of buying and it's coming back," said a U.S. Treasury bond trader in London. "It's fully pricing in no move on rates."
The U.S. 30 year long bond was trading at 97-30, yielding 6.53 percent by 0920 GMT compared with 97-20 in Tokyo and 98-03 at the New York close.
The FOMC meets at 1300 GMT, and a result is expected to be announced at about 1815 GMT.

A Reuters poll showed a consensus among 31 economists that the Fed would leave interest rates on hold at the meeting. The federal funds target rate is currently at 5.50 percent, after it was raised by 25 basis points in March.

"The most convincing argument for no rate hike is that the inflation numbers have been benign," said Ian Morris, international economist at HSBC James Capel in London. "Producer prices in particular have fallen for seven consecutive months. It would be hard to justify a move, politically."
Morris said he would not be a buyer until the long-bond yield was around 6.8 percent.
"The economy still has quite a bit of momentum," he said, adding he expected interest rates to be raised in September or November in reaction to a bounce in third quarter growth.
September T-bond futures were down 1/32 at 114-02 in automated trade, after falling as low as 113-23 overnight.
The trader said the market was better bid, and would show little reaction after the FOMC announced its decision.
Economic data due for release included July housing starts at 1230 GMT, and July import and export prices at 1400 GMT.
December Eurodollar futures were unchanged at 94.160.
